input.summary: Kovai Finechem (V01, contact R. Selvam, Sales). Sent offer in their own ERP format (Kovai_Finechem_Offer.xlsx) and a COA for propanediol only. Open: RM-002 density/grade confirmation (tries 1/3 used); knockout gaps COA for each line (B5) and SDS with transport class (H1); conversion (C2), OTIF (I1), need-by 20 Dec 2026 (E3), strength/assay (B2). input.subject: RE: RFx KPC-2026-014 - Density received, outstanding items
input.body:
Dear Mr. Selvam,

Thank you for the density figure of 1.26 g/mL at 25C for refined glycerine.

To close the glycerin point, please confirm:
1. Does 1.26 g/mL at 25C apply to the grade we quoted, Glycerin (vegetable, IP grade), spec >=99.5% purity? If your offered product is a different grade, state its density at the stated temperature.
2. Conversion: give the conversion from your selling unit to kilograms of net material for each line (for example, 1 drum = 200 kg net). A completed Annexure A also meets this requirement.
3. Strength/assay: for each line, state the strength or assay, the marker it is measured against and the test method. Our specifications are 98% active for D-Panthenol, 500 ppm peptide for Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3, and 1,000 ppm peptide for Copper Tripeptide-1.
4. Delivery: can you meet our first need-by date of 20 December 2026? If not, state your earliest date for the first delivery.
5. OTIF: state your on-time-in-full rate for these lines over the last 12 months and your definition of on-time.
6. Certificate of Analysis: provide a recent batch COA for each line (not only propanediol), showing batch number, manufacturing date and expiry or retest date. This is a mandatory requirement.
7. Safety Data Sheet: provide the current SDS for each line, including the transport hazard class. This is a mandatory requirement.

Please reply by 14 November 2026. Items 6 and 7 must be received before we can evaluate your offer further.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
